executive_summary: Ep 95 advances three threads. (1) YouTuber Nicci's analysis argues the back-camera footage Terryl shared was zoomed vs. wide-angle shots at other 2025 tour stops; the behind-head angle appeared only with the 2025 American Comeback Tour. (2) A tip describes a 2016 Scottsdale dinner with Lori Frantzve, Larry Ginta, gun-patent holders, and Erika Frantzve. (3) Candace rebuts Blake Neff's X-post on the Robinson charging document. Plus Laura Loomer's tweet, a 2019 Spectator profile, and a viewer question on whether Charlie Kirk was cremated.
